Public, no authentication — the login page shows the logo before anyone has signed in. Served only for the paths a `Branding` object's `logoUrl`/`faviconUrl` carry; file names are content-addressed, so responses are `Cache-Control: immutable` and a new logo is a new URL. Never reachable under `/uploads/`.
